translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Id Posivontuhan si Disas to mgo Minuvu to Kod-inguma Rin diyot Jerusalem
Na, to morani ron sikandan diyot Jerusalem, od kopantow ran don iddos bariyu to Betpahe no riyot banod to Buvungan to mgo Olibo. Id po-unna ni Disas dutun iddos oruwa taddot mgo tinodduwan din.

Kahi rin kandan to, “Undiyon kow to bariyu no riyot ko-unnan, woy to kod-inguma row rutun, idda ron en, od kokita row iddos asnu nid ikot duma to nati rin. Okasa row vo idda woy tuyuka row rinit koddi.
Otik duwon od intud koniyu, tovaka row no, ‘Od ko-ilonganon ini tod Longaggon woy go-os din da ini id po-uli.”
Nopuungan ini, su amoy od kotuman iddos id poponudtuu to Monama ukit to propeta no mid ungketen to,

content.text: no, ‘Od inguma ron kos koniyun hari no mopoobbava woy id sakoy sikandin to natit asnu.’ ”

content: Na mid ipanow iddos oruwon tinodduwan, woy id puungan dan kos id suhu ni Disas kandan.
Id tuyuk dan iddos asnu woy dos nati po-undiyon to ki Disas. Id ompasan dan idda to umpak, woy mid sakoy sikandin.
Mo-uraa kos minuvu rutun no id ampas to mgo umpak dan diyot daan nod ukitan din to kodposivantug kandin. Woy dos duma, id tampod to moollimot no mgo panga to kayu woy id ampas dan idda riyot daan.

Na, iddos mgo minuvu no riyot ko-unnan din woy dos id tinundug, id pehes dan no mid ungketen to, “Od doongon kos lubbad ni David. Od posivontuhan ta kos id popiyod to Monama nod Longaggon. Od doongon kos Monama riyot datas to langit!”
To kod-inguma ni Disas diyot Jerusalem, nohuyakot kos langun nid oubpa rutun woy kahi ran to, “Ondoy man inin minuvu?”
Mid tavak iddos mo-uraan minuvu nid tinundug kandin, kahi ran to, “Sikandin en si Disas, dos propeta no id pomon diyot Nazaret no sakup to Galilea.”
Id Pa-awa ni Disas iddos id Pombovoligya riyot Templo

Na mid usok si Disas diyot templo, woy id pa-awa rin iddos langun nod pombovoligya riyot lama woy dos id pombovolli rutun. Id ponlingkuwab din iddos mgo lomisa taddot tohodbovullas to soopi, woy id pompiloy rin iddos mgo unsaran taddot od pombovoligya to mgo soopati.
Mid ikahi sikandin to, “No-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: ‘Iddos Baoy't Monama, od ngoranan no baoy atag to koddasaa.’

content: Piru sikiyu, id bovallan dow moho ini nod oubpan to mgo tokawon!”
Na, duwon mgo butud woy mgo pungku no mid porani kandin diyot templo, woy id bowiyan din sikandan.

Piru iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises, oraroy ran no nolingasa to nokita ran iddos mokososoobbun pinuungan ni Disas woy to norinog dan no ahad iddos mgo anak, id pehes to kahaan no mid ungketen to, “Od doongon ta inis lubbad ni David!”

De-en id intud sikandan ki Disas, kahi ran to, “Norinog du vo iddos osengan dan?” Mid tavak si Disas to, “Oyya. Waa kow vo nokovasa taddot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no, ‘Ahad iddos moollimot poron no mgo anak, id nonawwan to Monama nod doong kandin?’
Na, mid tanan si Disas kandan woy id undiyon to Betania woy riyon sikandin id owwot.
Dos Moka-atag to Kayu no Igera no Waa id Bovunga
Na, to nosollom don to id livod onsi Disas diyot Jerusalem, id gutasan sikandin.

Nokita rin iddos kayu nod ngoranan to igera diyot ibpit to daan. Id porani sikandin tadda amoy'd ontongngan ko duwon bunga, piru paanan da en mgo do-un kos nokita rin. De-en id ikohiyan din iddos kayu to, “Pomon ko-ungkay, konna kad od bovunga.” Na idda ron en, nahangu iddos kayu.
To nokita idda taddot mgo tinodduwan din, oraroy ran no nosoobbuwan, kahi ran to, “Eh! Mambot tigkow moho nahangu ikon kayu?”

Kahin Disas kandan to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no otik duwon kopomakoy row woy waa kodduworuwa row, od kopuungan dow kos iling taddot id puungan ku ka-ay'n kayu. Woy konna ra idda, ahad od ikahi kow ra ka-ay't buvungan to, ‘Od ko-onnat ka woy'd poko-antug diyot dahat,’ od kopuungan en idda.
Ahad ondan kos od buyuwon dow riyon to Monama, id boggoy rin en idda koniyu otid pomakoy kow.”
Dos Intud Moka-atag to Kotungud ni Disas

Na, id livod si Disas diyot templo woy laggun tid nonaw sikandin, id porani kandin iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio. Kahi ran to, “Ondak kotungud du ka-ay't langun nid puungan du? Woy ondoy kos id boggoy kikow ka-ay'n kotungud?”
Mid tavak si Disas kandan to, “To dii ku pa od tovakon kos intud dow, duwon intud ku koniyu. Tovaka row ini, woy id ponudtuu ku koniyu ko ondoy kos id boggoy koddi to kotungud to kodpuung ka-ay.

Dos kotungud ni Juan to kodboutismu, id pomon bo riyot Monama o riyot minuvu?” Na id posisipoy ran kod monnuwon dan idda tod tavak, kahi ran to, “Otid ikahi ki no, ‘Iddos Monama kos id boggoy kandin to kotungud,’ na od ikahi sikandin to, ‘Mambot waa kow id pomakoy ki Juan?’
Piru otid ikahi ki no, ‘Minuvu kos id boggoy kandin to kotungud,’ na od kovaakkan ki to mgo minuvu, su id pomakoy ran no propeta en si Juan.”

De-en mid tavak sikandan to, “Waa koy nokosaddoo ko ingkon idda id pomon.” Na kahin Disas kandan to, “Ko ungketen, dii ku mandad sikiyu od ponudtulan ko ingkon id pomon kos kotungud ku to kodpuung ka-ay.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka-atag to Oruwon Anak no Mama

Na id itulan dan ni Disas to sokkad no ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Ondan kos poomdom dow moka-atag ka-ay? Duwon sokkad no amoy no oruwa kos anak din no mama. Id ikahi sikandin diyot kakoy to, ‘Anak, undiyon ka to ubasan ko-ungkay'n allow woy puung ka rutun.’
Mid tavak iddos kakoy to, ‘Dii a.’ Piru riyot mori, nopalin kos poomdom din woy id undiyon sikandin to ubasan.
Na iddos amoy, id undiyon mandad to ari, woy ungketen dad en kos id suhu rin. Mid tavak iddos ari to, ‘Oyya, od undiyon a en.’ Piru waa man sikandin id undiyon.”

Kahin Disas to, “Na atag koniyu, ingkon musing taddot oruwon anak kos id tuman taddot id kopi-i to amoy ran?” Id tavak sikandan to, “Idda en so kakoy.” De-en mid ikahi si Disas to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no iddos mgo mosaasaan minuvu iling to oray'd loimbung no mgo tohodsukut to buhis woy dos mgo ba-ay nod bovoligya to lawa ran, od unna sikandan koniyu nod lonug to kodharit Monama.

Su iddot mid undini si Juan no Tohodboutismu woy id nonaw koniyu to motallong no ko-ubpa, waa kow moho id pomakoy kandin. Piru iddos oray'd loimbung no mgo tohodsukut to buhis woy dos morat no mgo ba-ay, id pomakoy ran kandin. Ahad pe-en nokita row nid pomakoy ran, waa kow mid sondit woy'd tanan to koniyun mgo saa woy waa kow id pomakoy kandin.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka-atag to id Pomursintu to Ubasan

Na kahin Disas kandan to, “Pominogga row inis ossa pa no ponunggelengan. Duwon sokkad no minuvu no id pomuwa to ubas diyot kamot din. Na id kuralan din idda, woy id bovaa sikandin tod toviran to ubas, woy id poohinat sikandin to motikang no sabbung nod ubpan tod tamong tadda. Nopongnga, id popursintuwan din iddos kamot woy id undiyon sikandin to osson ingod.
To timpu ron to kodpomupu to ubas, id suhu rin kos mgo sudsuhuwon din diyot id pomursintu amoy'd angoy to kandin no taad.
Piru to kod-inguma taddot mgo sudsuhuwon din, id ammot dan taddot id pomursintu. Dos sokkad, id pomodasan dan, dos sokkad, id imotayan woy dos sokkad, id ponlumbahan dan to batu taman tid patoy.
Na, id suhu mandon taddot komunoy iddos duma pon mgo sudsuhuwon no mo-uraa pa taddot unna, piru ungketen dad en kos id puungan taddot id pomursintu.
Diyot mori, id suhu taddot komunoy iddos anak din, su kohingginawa rin to, ‘Od rispituwon dan en kos anak ku.’

Piru to nokita taddot id pomursintu no idda ron so anak to komunoy kos od inguma, id po-ikohiyoy ran to, ‘Ika ron kos anak to komunoy. Kuo kid, od imotayan ta sikandin amoy siketa ron kos od pokokomunoy ka-ay't ubasan!’
De-en id goyod dan sikandin po-undiyot leggua to ubasan woy id imotayan.”
Na kahin Disas to, “Ondan ayu kos od puungan taddot komunoy to ubasan diyot id pomursintu?”
Mid tavak sikandan to, “Od imotayan din en iddon morat no mgo minuvu, woy od popursintuwan din iddos ubasan to ossa nod boggoy kandin to taad diyot timpu to kodpomupu to ubas.”
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Waa kow vo nokovasa taddot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: ‘Iddos batu no id oovoddan to tohodbovaoy su kunan dan ko waa koru-anon, idda vos en kos batu no mosalig no po-unsaran. Dos od Longaggon kos id puung tadda, woy motoos idda nod tongtongngan.’

content: Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “De-en od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no konnad sikiyu no mgo Judio kos od kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama, ko konna, idda ron so mgo minuvu nod tuman to kandin nid kopi-i.
[Iddos ahad ondoy nod pokovuntug taddon batu, od kotoppuwan en, woy dos od ko-uuhan tadda, od koubpot en.”]
To norinog taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy taddot mgo Pariseo iddos mgo ponunggelengan ni Disas, noovottan dan no sikandan kos id suhat din.
Purisu od omotton dan nanoy sikandin, piru novaakkan dan taddot mo-uraan minuvu, su id pomakoy ran no propeta en si Disas.

footnotes.text: Inis Sion, osson ngaran to Jerusalem.
Od kovasa ini riyot Isaias 62:11; Zacarias 9:9.
